text: hey, so uh, we might already have most of the ability to do this but, so i made this bong [Image #9] and i was thinking to before i scale it down, export out a copy of it that is this massive size, but i want to put it like, as a business sign, where the sign, basically has a bong that is just spinning around and is on some platform above the door right. i can make everything the only part i dont know is the spinning part.
resolution: Built the spinning-prop capability end to end (the only missing piece of the business-sign ask — giant export + platform the user already has). A placed authored prop now takes a Spin quick verb (right-click menu / Build > Spin Piece): an undoable world.piece.spin transaction sets PlacedPiece.spinDegPerSec (45°/s toggle, persists with the map), livePush carries it on a new v2 live-mesh wire behind a presence-gated host door (__compiled_world_set_live_mesh_props2 — older host falls back to v1, no misparse), and world_loader draws the prop at yaw + rate x clock every frame. Visual-only per the ticker/traffic law: colliders, door state, and placement identity keep the authored yaw. Spins in both the iso viewport and the playtest tab off the one push. Tests green (pieceEditCommand 9/9, meshProps 4/4); docs/game/editor_spin_props.md + index record added (baked-gamefile spin flagged as the compile-lane follow-up). NEEDS A HOST REBUILD to see props turn — the running dev host predates the new door.
